answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's earnings stay locked for about 20 epochs and are clawed back if graders later flag its answers as copies. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must carry every one through a long voyage of honest work before any reward unlocks, so a zephyr of cheap accounts yields nothing liquid, and one fraud ruling burns all pending balances, leaving the farm a worthless relic.
